presets.description: A full piano accordion, every reed modelled from the physics: Clarinet in the treble, all five bass reeds, an ORTF pair in a small room.
presets.name: Accordion

presets.description: The Paris bal-musette: three middle reeds tuned wide, open, in a dance hall.
presets.name: Musette Paris

presets.description: The Scottish dance band's very wet musette, on stage with clip-on mics.
presets.name: Scottish Dance Band

presets.description: The Italian tremolo: three middle reeds, a moderate shimmer, a spaced pair.
presets.name: Italian Folk

presets.description: The German and Alpine sound: bassoon and two middle reeds, a gentle tremolo.
presets.name: Alpine

presets.description: The Slovenian polka sound: three middle reeds, the true one in the tone chamber.
presets.name: Oberkrainer

presets.description: The American Slovenian polka: three middle reeds nearly dry, open, on stage.
presets.name: Cleveland Polka

presets.description: The American tuning: two middle reeds with a light beat.
presets.name: American

presets.description: The Irish dance tuning: two middle reeds in swing, a slow beat, in a pub.
presets.name: Irish Swing

presets.description: The jazz accordion: bassoon and middle reed in the tone chamber, dry and round.
presets.name: Jazz

presets.description: Towards the bandoneon: a middle reed and its octave, dry, close-miked.
presets.name: Tango

presets.description: The concert accordion: bassoon, middle reed and piccolo, dry, through the tone chamber, in a hall.
presets.name: Concert

presets.description: Both hands on one 61-key keyboard: chords in the octave below middle C, bass notes below them.
presets.name: 61-Key Keyboard

presets.description: The modulation wheel is the bellows: move it to play, up opens, down closes.
presets.name: Wheel as Bellows

presets.description: The bellows runs out and turns by itself, between notes where it can.
presets.name: Auto Bellows

presets.description: For a digital accordion: its bellows sensor sets the pressure directly, bass and chords on their own MIDI channels.
presets.name: Digital Accordion
